(1) Historical claims, pp.~15--16: for the binomial case (2.5) the inequalities of Theorem 1, except (2.2) with mu<1/2, were derived by Okamoto [11], and (2.1) for the binomial case is implicitly contained in Chernoff [3, Theorem 1 and Example 5]; neither Okamoto nor Chernoff appears anywhere in the handbook.
